quote.text: At what time soever thou wilt, it is in thy power to retire into thyself, and to be at rest, and free from all businesses.
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood:
    • When tending to your children, remember that your inner calm is a wellspring of strength; by nurturing your own tranquility, you set a positive example for them.
    • Withdrawal into oneself can provide a respite from the daily demands of parenting, allowing you to recharge and ultimately offer deeper, more compassionate care.
  • Leadership:
    • As a leader, it is essential to find moments for introspection; by stepping away from external noise, you cultivate the clarity needed to guide others wisely.
    • Retiring into yourself enables you to reassess your actions and strategies, ensuring that your decisions are grounded in calm rationality and a clear vision for the future.
  • Product Management:
    • In the fast-paced realm of product management, carving out time for self-reflection can lead to more innovative solutions and a balanced perspective amidst constant change.
    • By retreating within, you allow for creative rejuvenation, thereby enhancing your ability to navigate complex challenges and prioritize tasks effectively.
